takeaways: Crystal (additional from Vaal Beacons) is the only premium solo: curve E[p]≈1230ex; floor asks ~775.
Almost everything else prices into a flat ~75–80ex mid band (slightly above dump ~60) — treat as low-B / soft-junk for Temple, not true premium.
Quantity filters (both T1 and T2) returned no liquid results alone or with pack — thin book, don't calibrate tiers from qty yet.
Monster Effectiveness solo is mid-band (80). Paired with Crystal (or Pack+Crystal) it still sells at 775 — no observed multiplier premium on trade.
Temple market appears single-mod driven: buyers pay for Crystal; pack/eff/rarity do not stack price.
Chaos ~1/32.5 to crystal + alch/magic presence → wc≈2210. At that rate chaos-until-crystal loses to dump; prefer reforge 3→1 (dump residual <3) when marginal vs list is positive for Reforge.
